Therefore means ± SEM and some points may be reproducible only partially without clarifying missing values and exact sample-to-condition assignments.

As for (F): Fig1G (SOX17-Tom and NKX2-5-GFP positive proportions) has supporting replicate columns in the Fig1E-G spreadsheet, but the file preview shows some missing replicate entries and the mapping/labeling of replicates is not fully explicit. This limits exact reproduction of plotted means and SEM for every concentration/condition.

Fig1I source file ('Figure 1I_data.xlsx') is present and contains NKX2-5 and FOXA2 values with sample names that appear to encode treatment and population (e.g., 'SB_g0_t0_rep1'), which supports reproduction of boxplots by population. Clarification of normalization steps and explicit population grouping in the file would be needed for a fully faithful replication.
